{{Quote|The ''Jedi Council'' recently learned ''Clan Besaddii [sic]'' has been secretly funnelling the casino's profits to the ''Separatists''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Kanto Raka]]|<ref name="The Professional!">{{TCWComicCite|6.12|The Professional!}}</ref>}}
'''Katalla''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was a casino world considered to be a respite from conflict. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] clan had a money funneling scheme with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]]. The clan used the [[Katalla casino|Katalla casino]] to generate funds for the Separatists. The plot was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
